source_caption:
Train Dreams (2025) 🌲

One of the most gorgeous yet deeply soulful films. It follows the life of Robert Grainier, a logger in the American West who experiences a world changing as fast as the nature around him. It’s a quiet, powerful journey about love, loss, and the endurance of the human spirit.  Joel Edgerton delivers a deeply restrained, soulful performance never loud, never showy just pure, lived-in humanity. The cinematography lets silence speak, and every frame feels soaked in longing. Not a film that begs for tears, but one that stays with you long after it ends. I was thinking that-

It just won Best Cinematography at the 2026 Critics Choice Awards and earned @joeledgerton a Golden Globe nomination for Best Actor.

Cnematographer Adolpho Veloso shot 99% of the movie using only natural light. They even used a rare 3:2 aspect ratio to mimic the look of vintage photographs from the early 1900s. It’s no surprise it just won Best Cinematography at the 2026 Critics Choice Awards.

source_details.synopsis: Train Dreams is a 2025 American period drama film directed by Clint Bentley, who co-wrote the screenplay with Greg Kwedar, based on the 2011 novella by Denis Johnson. The film stars Joel Edgerton, Felicity Jones, Nathaniel Arcand, Clifton Collins Jr., John Diehl, Paul Schneider, Kerry Condon, and William H. Macy, with narration from Will Patton. Train Dreams had its world premiere at the 2025 Sundance Film Festival on January 26, 2025, and was released in select theaters in the United States on November 7, 2025, before its streaming debut by Netflix on November 21, 2025.
